title: Meridian Global Bank Inter-Agent Message Protocol Schema
description: Authoritative JSON Schema for all inter-agent communication, escalation, and coordination envelopes across TM-01, CS-01, RU-01, and RG-01.

message_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this message envelope (UUID v4).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision at envelope creation.

sender_agent_id.description: Canonical identifier of the originating agent or human service principal.

oneOf.description: Multicast list of recipient agent identifiers.

correlation_id.description: UUID linking all related messages in a conversational saga or investigation chain.

trace_id.description: Distributed OpenTelemetry tracing identifier across microservices and agents.

payload_schema.description: Identifier specifying the structured schema of the inner payload (e.g., alert.insider-trading.v1).

payload.description: Message-type-specific structured content, evidence tokens, parameters, or narratives.

confidence_score.description: Agent subjective belief mass or model probability regarding the violation assertion.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds before the envelope is expired or dropped.

retry_count.description: Count of delivery attempts made (0 for original transmission).

audit_classification.description: Legal audit taxonomy determining statutory retention duration (e.g., REGULATORY = 7-10 years).

sender_signature.description: Base64-encoded asymmetric digital signature (ECDSA P-384 or RSA-4096) computed over message payload digest.

nonce.description: Cryptographically secure pseudo-random one-time string preventing replay attacks.
